title: imponderable — charlatan

sentences.sentence: The effect of his new method is imponderable.
sentences.translation: 他的新方法所起的作用是无法正确估计的。

sentences.sentence: Our resources in technical knowledge are imponderable.
sentences.translation: 我们的技术知识资源是无法估量的。

sentences.sentence: Our imponderable resources in knowledge are constantly growing and are inexhaustible.
sentences.translation: 我们无法估量的知识资源是不断发展永不枯竭的。

sentences.sentence: He prayed to God night and day endue him with the spirit of holiness.
sentences.translation: 他日夜祈求上帝赋予他虔敬的心。

sentences.sentence: The value of life is up to the ultimate mission you endue with yourself .
sentences.translation: 生命的价值取决于你赋予自己的终极使命。

sentences.sentence: The society endues us the mission , and the clients endue us the responsibility !
sentences.translation: 社会赋予我们使命，客户赋予我们责任！

sentences.sentence: All of a sudden a storm broke – a regular cloudburst.
sentences.translation: 突然暴风雨来临了—一场常见的大暴雨。

sentences.sentence: A dramatic cloudburst releases jagged bolts of lightning deep into the Grand Canyon near Point Sublime.
sentences.translation: 突发的倾盆大雨向崇敬角附近的大峡谷深处释放了一道锯齿状闪电。

sentences.sentence: The cloudburst masterplan for Copenhagen, the capital of Denmark, is an example of an ambitious effort to protect the city against future heavy rain events.
sentences.translation: 作为此方面的典范，丹麦首都哥本哈根市的暴雨防控规划提出了一套雄心勃勃的计划，旨在帮助城市免受未来的暴雨之害。

sentences.sentence: We want to dispel the myth that you cannot eat well in Britain.
sentences.translation: 我们要消除在英国吃不好的误解。

sentences.sentence: Light poured into the hall, dispelling the shadows.
sentences.translation: 阳光洒进大厅，驱散了阴影。

sentences.sentence: A man can scarce allege his own merits with modesty, much less extol them; a man cannot sometimes brook to supplicate or beg; and a number of the like.
sentences.translation: 一个人不能自承有功而免矜夸之嫌，更不用说是不能表扬自己底功绩了；他有时也不能低首下心地去有所恳求；诸如此类的事很多。

sentences.sentence: an ignominious end to his career
sentences.translation: 他职业生涯不光彩的终结

phrases.translation: 生活的调味品；使人高兴的事
香料群岛（等于Moluccas，印度尼西亚东北部马鲁古群岛）

sentences.sentence: They spiced their conversations and discussions with intrigue.
sentences.translation: 他们通过设谜为他们的谈话和讨论增加乐趣。

sentences.sentence: Phenomenological pedagogy calls for the rediscovery and return of human spirits in educational practice.
sentences.translation: 现象学教育学呼唤教育实践之人文精神的重新发现与回归。

sentences.sentence: The Cartesian perspective assumes that knowledge is a kind of substance and that pedagogy concerns the best way to transfer this substance from teachers to students.
sentences.translation: 笛卡尔的观点假设知识是一种物质，并认为教育学关注的最好方法，以把这种物质由老师转移给学生。

sentences.sentence: They proudly declared themselves part of a new autonomous province.
sentences.translation: 他们自豪地宣布自己是新自治省的一部分。

translations.translation: 感知， 知觉； 洞察力

phrases.translation: 美感，审美观念；审美知觉

sentences.sentence: It did not require a lot of perception to realize the interview was over.
sentences.translation: 不需要很强的洞察力就可以意识到面试结束了。

sentences.sentence: ...a 13-year-old boy whose crime file includes violence, theft, vandalism and bullying.
sentences.translation: …一个犯罪档案中包括暴力、偷窃、破坏公物和恃强凌弱的13岁男孩。

translations.translation: 承担； 担保， 保证

sentences.sentence: She undertook the task of monitoring the elections.
sentences.translation: 她承担了监督选举的任务。

sentences.sentence: The raw material for the tyre is a byproduct of oil refining.
sentences.translation: 这种轮胎的原料是汽油提炼的副产品。

sentences.sentence: The metal mouthpiece of a bridle, serving to control, curb, and direct an animal.
sentences.translation: 马勒， 嚼子放在嘴里的金属制马勒，用于控制约束和驾御牲畜。

sentences.sentence: Millions more suffer from serious sleep deprivation caused by long work hours.
sentences.translation: 还有数百万人由于工作时数长导致他们严重睡眠不足。

sentences.sentence: I sympathize with the introvert as I would with the sickly, but both are missing a lot of life.
sentences.translation: 我会像体谅体弱病残的人那样，体谅性格内向的人，但两者都失去许多人生体验。

sentences.sentence: Introverts can have friends ok. I mean, I'm an introvert and I have no friends, but some do. Maybe. Not sure actually.
sentences.translation: 内向的人也可以拥有朋友，嗯，我说的是，我是一个内向的人我没有朋友，但是很多内向人也有朋友。是这样的吧？也许是吧？

sentences.sentence: Many colleges will help future career seekers to evaluate self- personality to see if they are introvert, extrovert, detail-oriented or concept / idea persons.
sentences.translation: 许多大学帮助未来的求职者估量自己性格是否属于内向、外向、倾向细节或有创造性的人。

phrases.translation: 大门，正门入口；主要入口
进口许可证；入境许可证；入境证

sentences.translation: 她甜美的嗓音令我陶醉。

translations.translation: 混杂的； 多色的， 杂色的

sentences.sentence: ...a motley collection of vans, old buses, cattle trucks, and even a fire engine.
sentences.translation: ...杂七杂八的一堆车，有运货车、旧公共汽车、运牛卡车，甚至有一辆消防车。

sentences.sentence: The charlatan boasted that he could charm off any disease.
sentences.translation: 这个江湖骗子吹牛说他能用符咒治好各种疾病。

sentences.sentence: Incapable of moral clarity, he could never quite admit to himself that he was a charlatan and that his scheme was an impossible fiasco.
sentences.translation: 由于缺乏明确的道德准则，他从来不承认自己是一个江湖骗子以及他的计划是个彻底的失败品。

sentences.sentence: If you are too trusting of the invisible, then you buy that $89 ebook that comes with the promise of instant riches, or you sign up for ear candling, or invest time and money with a charlatan.
sentences.translation: 如果你对这些无形的事物相当信任，那么你可能会花89美元买一个承诺给你一夜暴富的电子书，或报名参加一次耳烛疗法，或跟一个江湖郎中花费你的时间和金钱。

text:
英语词汇 · GRE · 第 407 单元

imponderable
音标：英 /ɪm'pɑːndərəbl/  美 /ɪm'pɑndərəbl/
adj.  无法衡量的
例句：The effect of his new method is imponderable.
他的新方法所起的作用是无法正确估计的。
例句：Our resources in technical knowledge are imponderable.
我们的技术知识资源是无法估量的。
例句：Our imponderable resources in knowledge are constantly growing and are inexhaustible.
我们无法估量的知识资源是不断发展永不枯竭的。

endue
音标：英 /ɪn'djuː/
v.  赋予， 授予
短语：endue with — v. 赋予；使穿上
例句：He prayed to God night and day endue him with the spirit of holiness.
他日夜祈求上帝赋予他虔敬的心。
例句：The value of life is up to the ultimate mission you endue with yourself .
生命的价值取决于你赋予自己的终极使命。
例句：The society endues us the mission , and the clients endue us the responsibility !
社会赋予我们使命，客户赋予我们责任！

cloudburst
音标：英 /'klaudbɜːrst/  美 /'klaʊdbɝst/
n.  大暴雨
例句：All of a sudden a storm broke – a regular cloudburst.
突然暴风雨来临了—一场常见的大暴雨。
例句：A dramatic cloudburst releases jagged bolts of lightning deep into the Grand Canyon near Point Sublime.
突发的倾盆大雨向崇敬角附近的大峡谷深处释放了一道锯齿状闪电。
例句：The cloudburst masterplan for Copenhagen, the capital of Denmark, is an example of an ambitious effort to protect the city against future heavy rain events.
作为此方面的典范，丹麦首都哥本哈根市的暴雨防控规划提出了一套雄心勃勃的计划，旨在帮助城市免受未来的暴雨之害。

dispel
音标：英 /dɪ'spel/  美 /dɪ'spɛl/
v.  驱散， 消除
例句：We want to dispel the myth that you cannot eat well in Britain.
我们要消除在英国吃不好的误解。
例句：Light poured into the hall, dispelling the shadows.
阳光洒进大厅，驱散了阴影。

supplicate
音标：英 /'sʌplɪk3ɪt/  美 /'sʌplikeit/
v.  恳求， 祈求
例句：A man can scarce allege his own merits with modesty, much less extol them; a man cannot sometimes brook to supplicate or beg; and a number of the like.
一个人不能自承有功而免矜夸之嫌，更不用说是不能表扬自己底功绩了；他有时也不能低首下心地去有所恳求；诸如此类的事很多。

ignominious
音标：英 /ˌɪgnə'mɪniəs/  美 /,ɪɡnə'mɪnɪəs/
adj.  可耻的； 耻辱的
例句：an ignominious end to his career
他职业生涯不光彩的终结

spice
音标：英 /spaɪs/  美 /spaɪs/
v.  给…调味
n. 香料
短语：spice of life — 生活的调味品；使人高兴的事
短语：spice girls — 英国辣妹组合
短语：spice islands — 香料群岛（等于Moluccas，印度尼西亚东北部马鲁古群岛）
例句：They spiced their conversations and discussions with intrigue.
他们通过设谜为他们的谈话和讨论增加乐趣。

pedagogy
音标：英 /'pedəgɑːdʒi/  美 /'pɛdə'godʒi/
n.  教育学， 教学法
例句：Phenomenological pedagogy calls for the rediscovery and return of human spirits in educational practice.
现象学教育学呼唤教育实践之人文精神的重新发现与回归。
例句：The Cartesian perspective assumes that knowledge is a kind of substance and that pedagogy concerns the best way to transfer this substance from teachers to students.
笛卡尔的观点假设知识是一种物质，并认为教育学关注的最好方法，以把这种物质由老师转移给学生。

autonomous
音标：英 /ɔː'tɑːnəməs/  美 /ɔ'tɑnəməs/
adj.  自治的； 自主的
短语：autonomous region — 自治区
短语：autonomous county — 自治县
短语：autonomous prefecture — 自治州
短语：autonomous system — 自治系统；独立系统
短语：autonomous operation — 独立作战；自仲作
例句：They proudly declared themselves part of a new autonomous province.
他们自豪地宣布自己是新自治省的一部分。

perception
音标：英 /pər'sepʃn/  美 /pɚ'sɛpʃən/
n.  感知， 知觉； 洞察力
短语：visual perception — 视觉感知；视知觉
短语：aesthetic perception — 美感，审美观念；审美知觉
短语：depth perception — [心]深度知觉
短语：sensory perception — n. 感官知觉
短语：sense perception — n. 感觉
短语：motion perception — 运动知觉
短语：spatial perception — 空间知觉
短语：pain perception — 痛知觉
短语：consumer perception — 消费者知觉
短语：extrasensory perception — 超感知觉
短语：perception and understanding — 感知与理解
短语：role perception — 角色知觉
例句：It did not require a lot of perception to realize the interview was over.
不需要很强的洞察力就可以意识到面试结束了。

vandalism
音标：英 /'vændəlɪzəm/  美 /'vændəlɪzəm/
n.  恶意破坏
例句：...a 13-year-old boy whose crime file includes violence, theft, vandalism and bullying.
…一个犯罪档案中包括暴力、偷窃、破坏公物和恃强凌弱的13岁男孩。

catalyze
音标：英 /'kætəlaɪz/  美 /'kætə,laɪz/
v.  促使； 激励

undertake
音标：英 /ˌʌndər'teɪk/  美 /,ʌndɚ'tek/
v.  承担； 担保， 保证
例句：She undertook the task of monitoring the elections.
她承担了监督选举的任务。

byproduct
音标：英 /'baɪˌprɑːdʌkt/  美 /'baɪ,prɑdəkt/
n.  副产品； 副作用
例句：The raw material for the tyre is a byproduct of oil refining.
这种轮胎的原料是汽油提炼的副产品。

bridle
音标：英 /'braɪdl/  美 /'braɪdl/
v.  抑制， 控制
n. 马笼头
短语：put a bridle on — 约束，控制
例句：The metal mouthpiece of a bridle, serving to control, curb, and direct an animal.
马勒， 嚼子放在嘴里的金属制马勒，用于控制约束和驾御牲畜。

deprivation
音标：英 /ˌdeprɪ'veɪʃn/  美 /,dɛprɪ'veʃən/
n.  剥夺； 丧失
短语：sleep deprivation — 睡眠剥夺，剥夺睡眠
短语：relative deprivation — [社会]相对剥夺；相对性匮乏
例句：Millions more suffer from serious sleep deprivation caused by long work hours.
还有数百万人由于工作时数长导致他们严重睡眠不足。

introvert
音标：英 /'ɪntrəvɜːrt/  美 /'ɪntrəvɝt/
n.  性格内向的人
例句：I sympathize with the introvert as I would with the sickly, but both are missing a lot of life.
我会像体谅体弱病残的人那样，体谅性格内向的人，但两者都失去许多人生体验。
例句：Introverts can have friends ok. I mean, I'm an introvert and I have no friends, but some do. Maybe. Not sure actually.
内向的人也可以拥有朋友，嗯，我说的是，我是一个内向的人我没有朋友，但是很多内向人也有朋友。是这样的吧？也许是吧？
例句：Many colleges will help future career seekers to evaluate self- personality to see if they are introvert, extrovert, detail-oriented or concept / idea persons.
许多大学帮助未来的求职者估量自己性格是否属于内向、外向、倾向细节或有创造性的人。

entrance
音标：英 /'entrəns/  美 /(for v.)ɪnˈtræns; (for n.) ˈɛntrəns/
v.  使出神， 使入迷
短语：entrance examination — 入学考试
短语：college entrance examination — 高考；大学入学考试
短语：main entrance — 大门，正门入口；主要入口
短语：entrance exams — 入学考试（entrance exam的复数）
短语：entrance door — 入口门，进口门
短语：entrance fee — 入场费
短语：entrance hall — n. 门廊
短语：university entrance examination — 高考；大学入学考试
短语：front entrance — 前门入口；正门入口
短语：entrance pressure — 入口压力
短语：entrance gate — 入口门；进水闸
短语：no entrance — 闲人免进；禁止入内
短语：entrance requirement — 入学要求；入学条件
短语：side entrance — n. 侧门
短语：grand entrance — 大厅入口
短语：entrance angle — 入射角；进入角
短语：entrance permit — 进口许可证；入境许可证；入境证
例句：I was entranced by the sweetness of her voice.
她甜美的嗓音令我陶醉。

motley
音标：英 /'mɑːtli/  美 /'mɑtli/
adj.  混杂的； 多色的， 杂色的
例句：...a motley collection of vans, old buses, cattle trucks, and even a fire engine.
...杂七杂八的一堆车，有运货车、旧公共汽车、运牛卡车，甚至有一辆消防车。

charlatan
音标：英 /'ʃɑːrlətən/  美 /'ʃɑrlətən/
n.  江湖郎中， 骗子
例句：The charlatan boasted that he could charm off any disease.
这个江湖骗子吹牛说他能用符咒治好各种疾病。
例句：Incapable of moral clarity, he could never quite admit to himself that he was a charlatan and that his scheme was an impossible fiasco.
由于缺乏明确的道德准则，他从来不承认自己是一个江湖骗子以及他的计划是个彻底的失败品。
例句：If you are too trusting of the invisible, then you buy that $89 ebook that comes with the promise of instant riches, or you sign up for ear candling, or invest time and money with a charlatan.
如果你对这些无形的事物相当信任，那么你可能会花89美元买一个承诺给你一夜暴富的电子书，或报名参加一次耳烛疗法，或跟一个江湖郎中花费你的时间和金钱。
